serviceDescription:
The data sets shown include:  
Land Parcels from Digital Cadastre Data (DCDB) - updated nightly  
The "Land Parcels" group layer has sub-layers that show selected land parcels at different scale ranges to aid visualisation and drawing speed.

Addresses from the Queensland Address Management Framework database - updated nightly

Location including -  
Populated Places from the Queensland Place Names database - updated nightly  
State Border - updated as required  
Coastline - updated as required

Administrative Boundaries including -  
Local Government Areas - updated quarterly  
Locality Boundaries - updated quarterly

documentInfo.Title: LandParcelPropertyFramework
documentInfo.Comments:
The data sets shown include:  Land Parcels from Digital Cadastre Data (DCDB) - updated nightly  The "Land Parcels" group layer has sub-layers that show selected land parcels at different scale ranges to aid visualisation and drawing speed.   In addition the Land Parcels are also presented based on base, easement, strata and volumetric  coverage types.    Addresses from the Queensland Address Management Framework database - updated nightly    Location including -  Populated Places from the Queensland Place Names database - updated nightly  State Border - updated as required  Coastline - updated as required    Administrative Boundaries including -  Local Government Areas - updated quarterly  Locality Boundaries - updated quarterlyThis service provides access to the following spatial datasets:
Addresses (prop.qld_location_address)
Land Parcels\Cadastral Natural Boundaries (prop.qld_dcdb/prop.qld_cadastre_natbdy)
Land Parcels\Parcel positional accuracy (prop.qld_dcdb/prop.qld_cadastre_dcdb)
Land Parcels\Cadastral parcels (prop.qld_dcdb/prop.qld_cadastre_dcdb)
Land Parcels\[Deprecated] Cadastral parcels - gt 1ha (prop.qld_dcdb/prop.qld_cadastre_dcdb)
Land Parcels\[Deprecated] Cadastral parcels - gt 10ha (prop.qld_dcdb/prop.qld_cadastre_dcdb)
Land Parcels\Base Parcels Only (prop.qld_dcdb/prop.qld_cadastre_dcdb)
Land Parcels\Easement Parcels Only (prop.qld_dcdb/prop.qld_cadastre_dcdb)
Land Parcels\Strata Parcels Only (prop.qld_dcdb/prop.qld_cadastre_dcdb)
Land Parcels\Volumetric Parcels Only (prop.qld_dcdb/prop.qld_cadastre_dcdb)
Land Parcels\Properties (built.build_ruralproperties)
Tenure (prop.qld_dcdb/prop.qld_cadastre_dcdb)
Location\Populated Places (built.qld_place_names_gazetteer)
Location\Queensland Coastline (prop.qld_statebdy_100k/prop.qld_statebdy_100k_l)
Location\Queensland Border (prop.qld_statebdy_100k/prop.qld_statebdy_100k_l)
Administrative Boundaries\Locality Boundaries (prop.qld_localitybdy_dcdb)
Administrative Boundaries\Local Government Areas (prop.qld_locgovbdy_dcdb)This service provides access to the following tabular datasets:
Building Unit Lot Plans (prop.qld_cadastre_bup_lot)
Lease and Reserve Details (prop.qld_ats_lease_reserve_data)
